meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
For a **wedding saree on a budget in India**, I’d prioritize **Banarasi organza, georgette, silk-blend Banarasi, and tissue**. They can look much more expensive than they are.

### My best picks

### [Banarasee Organza Mix Saree Zari]()
*₹1,999*

### [Koskii Mauve Organza Gold Saree]()
*₹2,394*

### [Banarasi Organza Silk Saree]()
*₹1,999*

### [Pulimoottil Silks Crushed Banarasi Sarees]()
*₹4,495*

### [Banarasee Floral Embroidered Work Saree]()
*₹1,899*

**Under ₹2,000 — best value:**  
- **Banarasi organza** in rani pink, emerald, royal blue, wine or mustard. It photographs beautifully and looks festive without being heavy. Current online options are around ₹1,600–₹2,000. [utsarees.in](https://utsarees.in/collections/organza-silk?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Silk-blend Banarasi** if you want a more traditional wedding appearance. There are plenty around ₹1,000–₹2,000, though check the fabric carefully—many inexpensive "silk" sarees are blends rather than pure silk. [www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/wedding-sarees-below-5000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**₹2,000–₹3,500 — my sweet spot:**  
- **Good-quality organza silk Banarasi** with a substantial zari border/pallu.
- **Tissue saree** in gold, champagne, pink or turquoise for a more glamorous reception look.
- **Embroidered georgette** if you prefer a softer, flowy drape.

**₹3,500–₹5,000 — splurge-within-budget:**  
- Look for a **lightweight genuine Banarasi** in georgette, Kora or organza. Heavy Katan silk at this price is a red flag; genuine lightweight Banarasi is much more realistic. [thepanaya.com](https://thepanaya.com/blogs/the-panaya/best-banarasi-sarees-under-rs-5000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### What I'd choose

| Wedding event | Saree I'd buy | Budget |
|---|---|---:|
| Haldi/mehendi | Yellow/green organza or georgette | ₹1,000–₹2,000 |
| Wedding | **Rani pink/red Banarasi organza** | ₹1,500–₹3,000 |
| Reception | **Tissue/organza with zari** | ₹2,000–₹3,500 |
| Traditional South Indian wedding | Silk-blend/soft silk with contrast zari border | ₹2,000–₹5,000 |


**One important tip:** don't chase "pure silk" or "pure Kanjivaram" listings at ₹700–₹1,500. At that price, they're often synthetic/blend fabrics despite the listing title. For a budget purchase, I'd rather buy a **beautiful, honestly labelled organza or silk-blend saree** than a supposedly "pure silk" saree of questionable authenticity. [thepanaya.com](https://thepanaya.com/blogs/the-panaya/best-banarasi-sarees-under-rs-5000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹1,500 / ₹3,000 / ₹5,000), age, skin tone, and whether you're the bride, sister, friend, or guest**, I can narrow it down to **5 specific sarees to buy online**.
